# m365-copilot-proxy Use Microsoft 365 Copilot as an LLM backend for OpenAI-compatible coding agents like [pi](https://pi.dev/) and [OpenClaw](https://docs.openclaw.ai/). Wraps M365 Copilot's WebSocket/SignalR API in an OpenAI-compatible interface with tool calling support. > **Want the gory protocol details?** See [docs/m365-copilot-api.md](docs/m365-copilot-api.md) — a full write-up of M365 Copilot's undocumented WebSocket API: auth, SignalR
